title: Schematically dense open subschemes
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $U\subset Z$ be open, with its canonical open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. The open $U$ is schematically dense if the canonical morphism of structure sheaves $\mathcal O_Z\to j_*\mathcal O_U$ is injective. Equivalently, for every open $W\subset Z$ the restriction homomorphism $\mathcal O_Z(W)\to\mathcal O_Z(W\cap U)$ is injective.
